summary: QTWO is a high-quality SaaS franchise priced for distress: ARR growth durable (+14% YoY through Q1 26), revenue +14% Q1 26, going-concern and audit clean (E&Y, no Item 4.01), $304M 2026 Notes fully cash-covered at 1.24x via $378M Q1 26 liquidity, and TAM corroborated by FDIC bank-scale data. Honesty-alpha catches: (a) revenue churn quietly worsened 4.4% → 5.2% YoY despite satisfaction narrative; (b) material 2H 2025 executive reshuffle (Coleman President resignation + Volanoski departure + Mukkamala promotion to COO) is disclosed via 8-K but cash impact buried in 'lease and other restructuring'; (c) insider cluster of 21 Form 4s in March 2026 (~48% of annual filings) at trough prices, including Coleman 10b5-1 plan adopted 11 days after his resignation. Drawdown reflects multiple-compression from SaaS de-rating + convert-overhang fear, not fraud or distress. Composite 0.429 = MOD-skew with PASS-dominant universal screens. LONG-leaning: structurally sound business with three legitimate but moderate honesty-alpha findings (churn, exec turnover framing, insider distribution timing) that complicate the recovery narrative but do not invalidate the franchise.
